==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon Ultimate Journeys - The Complete Season was released on July 23, 2024, by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 54 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000097935. Optional English closed captioning is included.

Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature.
